scope: The 35 LET source-scope rows recorded UNKNOWN before this review; three separate CSE structural placeholders are listed outside this target.
method: Crosswalk ids and question sets are sourced from the pre-change readiness collection and current canonical taxonomy. Questions and materials are not inferred from raw counts alone. PRC evidence establishes broad current exam outcomes; academic sources support concept instruction only.

classification_legend.VERIFIED: Authoritative scope source directly names the broad subject outcome; individual leaves remain BoardPrep organization unless the TOS names them.
classification_legend.CORRECTABLE: Broad PRC outcome supports the learning area and academic sources support the concept, but the theorist/construct is not individually named as a PRC TOS leaf.
classification_legend.DEFERRED: No supported evidence permits resolution; do not infer scope.
classification_legend.DETECTOR_LIMITATION: The readiness row aggregates multiple competencies/material pathways, so a single exact scope fit cannot be assigned.
